criteria.justification: The response explicitly identifies the meta-problem, stating that "the actual decision to be made in round four is different: how do we make a naming decision that stays decided."

The candidate acknowledges the "real cost (engineering rework, delayed launch, support/documentation churn) to continued delay" and proposes naming a "single decision-owner with authority to close the round" and setting an explicit bar for reopening.
The response recognizes that aiming for zero confusion is a trap ("'confusion exists' cannot be the bar for reopening") and distinguishes valid new usage data from a "renewed aesthetic objection."

The candidate explicitly accounts for the fixed API field name, concluding that "internal/external consistency is not and never will be an available design constraint" and appropriately drops that axis from consideration.

The response dismisses running the process like the first three rounds because "expecting a different result is not credible," instead demanding that stakeholders agree on ranked criteria before any wording is proposed.
